Markets.title: Lenskart Solutions among 7 stocks hitting 52-week highs; surge up to 20% in a month
Markets.summary: Seven BSE 200 stocks reached new 52-week highs as the Sensex rose by 113 points. Paytm led these companies with a 19% monthly increase, alongside Bosch, Lenskart Solutions, Aurobindo Pharma, Pidilite, Solar Industries India, and Zydus Lifesciences.

Markets.title: Quote of the day by Robert Kirby: "Cash really hurts if you hold it very long in an equity market that is compounding at close to 20% per annum"
Markets.summary: Holding excessive cash during strong equity markets creates a high opportunity cost that erodes long-term wealth creation. Investors should balance their liquidity needs with disciplined equity exposure to avoid missing out on market growth.

Markets.title: Tata Motors PV Q1 Results: Net profit plunges 80% YoY to Rs 775 crore, revenue rises 9%
Markets.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 775 crore for the first quarter of FY27, marking an 80% year-on-year decline from Rs 3,924 crore. Despite the drop in profit, the company's revenue increased by 9% during the same period.

Markets.title: Rupee slips, muted price action sinks volatility expectations to five-month low
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee weakened slightly on Thursday due to dollar outflows, derivative maturities, and overseas debt repayments. Meanwhile, central bank interventions pushed volatility expectations to a five-month low as India's trade deficit climbed to $31.98 billion in July.

Markets.title: PMS Tracker: Amaltas, Pluswealth Capital, Emkay, 7 others deliver up to 11% returns in July
Markets.summary: Multi-cap and flexi-cap Portfolio Management Services strategies dominated July's top performers with up to 11% returns. Amaltas Strategic Opportunities led the gains with 10.54% amid strong broader-market support.

Markets.title: Solar Industries shares jump 8% to fresh lifetime high after Q1 net profit soars 93% YoY to Rs 653 crore
Markets.summary: Solar Industries shares jumped over 8% to a record high after reporting a 93% year-over-year increase in Q1 net profit to Rs 652.55 crore. The surge was driven by strong business growth across defense and explosives, a Rs 21,350 crore order book, and optimistic revenue guidance.

Geo-Political.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Nobel Peace Prize winner Dmitry Muratov told the BBC that Vladimir Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine. Muratov stated that the Kremlin leader can only destroy Ukraine rather than conquer it as the war enters its fifth year.

Geo-Political.title: UK defends seizing shadow fleet tanker after Putin threat
Geo-Political.summary: The UK government defended its seizure of a shadow fleet tanker despite threats from Russian President Vladimir Putin. Officials stated that the enforcement action was conducted in full accordance with the law to disrupt and deter illicit vessels.

Geo-Political.title: More troops to be sent to West Bank village besieged by Israeli settlers
Geo-Political.summary: Additional military forces are being deployed to the West Bank village of Qusra following a siege by Israeli settlers. Two Palestinian families in the village have been trapped in their homes without water or power since Sunday.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
Geo-Political.summary: The WHO chief states that the Ebola outbreak, declared on May 15, is on track to become the deadliest in history. This epidemic has already caused over 2,000 deaths and thousands of additional reported cases.

Geo-Political.title: Travis Kelce shares first details from his wedding to Taylor Swift: 'Best night of my life'
Geo-Political.summary: Travis Kelce publicly referred to Taylor Swift as his wife for the first time in an online comment. He also shared that marrying her at Madison Square Garden was a childhood dream and the best night of his life.

Geo-Political.title: Eurovision Song Contest 2027 to be held in Burgas, Bulgaria
Geo-Political.summary: Burgas, Bulgaria, will host the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest. The Black Sea city was chosen following Bulgarian singer Dara's victory in this year's competition.

Data & Insights.title: India merchandise exports hit record $44.24 billion for July, trade deficit widens
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise exports reached a record $44.24 billion in July, driving total exports for the April-July period up 17% to $173.78 billion. Despite this growth, the country's trade deficit widened during the same timeframe.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase matched analyst expectations, which may provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and fuel prices, with elevated global oil prices posing ongoing risks.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the 20th consecutive year, citing a robust economic growth outlook of 6.4%. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university education obsolete. He also emphasizes that India's main challenge is ensuring workforce employability rather than simply creating jobs.

Data & Insights.title: India retail inflation likely remained unchanged at 4.4% in July: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation in July is expected to hold steady at 4.4%. This stability comes as a favorable base effect offset rising food prices while core inflation stayed contained.

India.title: Turban Came Off, Re-Tied: Moment Sukhbir Badal's Attacker Was Arrested
India.summary: Sukhbir Badal's attacker, Jaspal Singh, was arrested after the incident where Badal's turban came off and was subsequently re-tied. Police Superintendent Rohan Neelabh stated that Singh is currently being questioned to determine the motive behind the attack.

India.title: Nurse, 30, Found Dead At Kolkata Hospital, Toiled Door Broken To Recover Body
India.summary: A 30-year-old nurse was found dead inside a locked toilet at a Kolkata hospital after staff alerted the police. Authorities broke open the door and sent the body for a post-mortem examination.

India.title: Attacker Tried To Stab Sukhbir Badal In Stomach: What We Know So Far
India.summary: Shiromani Akali Dal chief Sukhbir Singh Badal survived an assassination attempt when an attacker tried to stab him in the stomach in Nanded. He has since been admitted to a private hospital for treatment.

India.title: NEET Counselling: Round 1 Registration, Choice Filling Schedule Revised, Check Key Dates
India.summary: The schedule for NEET UG 2026 counselling round one registration and choice filling has been revised. This counselling process determines admissions for MBBS, BDS, and BSc Nursing courses for the 2026 academic year.

India.title: Sukhbir Badal Attacked With Kirpan By Nihang Sikh At Gurudwara In Maharashtra
India.summary: Shiromani Akali Dal leader Sukhbir Badal was attacked with a kirpan by a Nihang Sikh at a Gurudwara in Maharashtra. He sustained a non-life-threatening hand injury and is receiving treatment at a private hospital in Nanded.

India.title: "Total Failure Of Intelligence": Akali Dal Leaders On Sukhbir Badal Attack
India.summary: Shiromani Akali Dal leader Sukhbir Singh Badal was injured in a knife attack in Nanded, Maharashtra, on Thursday. Following the incident, Akali Dal leaders criticized the event as a total failure of intelligence.

General.title: Met chief accepts mistakes made over Simon Levy but defends investigation into murders
General.summary: The Metropolitan Police chief has acknowledged mistakes were made in the handling of Simon Levy. However, the chief defended the overall police investigation into the murders.

General.title: Once-in-a-generation solar eclipse wows millions in UK and Europe
General.summary: Millions of people across the UK and Europe viewed a rare solar eclipse. The Moon covered more than 95% of the Sun in Cornwall and caused a total eclipse in parts of Spain.

General.title: Watch: Key moments from Karoline Leavitt's White House tenure as Trump says she will leave post
General.summary: Leavitt became the youngest press secretary in the country's history when she took the job in January 2025 at age 27.

General.title: Scientists invent 'world's greenest party balloon'
General.summary: Imperial College London scientists have invented what they describe as the world's greenest party balloon. This new balloon addresses the environmental problem of standard party balloons, which can take years to break down.
